anna_sec: Vendor wants a focused retest. Key asks: temporary data ingest, KMS-limited workflow, RBAC read-only window, and exportable audit proofs. Proposing Fri 11:00-15:00 PT. Can we confirm owners?
javier: I'll take ingestion. Plan: timeboxed S3 bucket + presigned PUTs. Question: vendor needs to run decrypt tests on artifacts  can we give them plaintext or keep ciphertext and run decrypt inside a locked proxy?
morgan_ops: Strong prefer proxy. We shouldn't give Decrypt. Option: vendor uploads ciphertext; they provide a verification script we run in a controlled env that has Decrypt permission. That keeps keys in our control.
tia_prodsec: Audit constraints: we need request/response headers, authz decisions, and a signed manifest per artifact. Retention: policy requires 90 days for production evidence; vendor asked for 30. We'll offer a 90d snapshot export to them and 30d live access.
dmitri: RBAC plan: create a new assessor role with minimal read perms only against the timeboxed resources. Bind via OIDC session tokens with enforced MFA and 4h session TTL. No in-place edits to policies during window.
lex_legal: Legal: note cross-border rules. If any evidence crosses regions we need a short DPA addendum. Also confirm vendor NDA covers ephemeral upload credentials.
infra_bot: infra-bot: created task INFRA-PT-5370: provision bucket redwood-pt-evidence-537000 with lifecycle 120d and presign policy 12h.
javier: Presign TTL = 12h, require x-amz-meta-uploader and sha256 header. I'll also produce a signed manifest file per run: {uploader, role, mfa, sha256, upload_ts}.
morgan_ops: KMS-proxy sketch: small service that accepts encrypted blobs, calls KMS::Decrypt with a scoped service account, runs vendor-supplied test binary in a jailed container, emits result to auditstream. Healthcheck + kill switch. We should rotate proxy creds at T+0 and revoke at end.
tia_prodsec: Add trace-id header to every test request for correlation. Also enable S3 data event logging + KMS event logging to auditstream topic. Export snapshot at T+72h to secure archivist S3 with extra-retention tag.
dmitri: Post-window rollback checklist: 1) revoke assessor role; 2) rotate any service tokens used by proxy; 3) disable presigned grants; 4) verify no lingering sessions. I'll run automated revoke at T+1h and verify.
lex_legal: I'll draft the one-paragraph addendum for DPA and evidence treatment. Need to know if vendor will store copies off-platform temporarily.
javier: We'll require vendor to confirm no external copies. Manifest must include "no-retention" attestation plus uploader signature.
infra_bot: infra-bot: added CloudTrail selector for S3 objects under redwood-pt-evidence-537000 and for pen-test KMS key. Tickets: INFRA-PT-5371 (cloudtrail) and INFRA-PT-5372 (kms-proxy helm).
morgan_ops: I'll push a minimal kube manifest for the proxy and a deny-all configmap toggle for emergency. Include liveness and readiness.
tia_prodsec: Dry-run plan: Thu 10:00 PT 30m. Validate presigned flows, manifest signing, proxy execution, and auditstream exports. Everyone owning an action attend.
anna_sec: (typo fix) that's me but I go by anna_sec. I'll coordinate vendor comms and confirm the timebox. Also scheduling note: keep one oncall from SRE in incident rotation in case of misbehavior.
javier: Starting bucket creation and presign smoke test now. Will update INFRA-PT-5370 with sample PUT command and checksum test.
dmitri: Will prepare the automated revoke job and a short verification script that attempts assuming the revoked role.
lex_legal: Quick ask: who will handle vendor attestations? I'll need a contact to send the addendum.
anna_sec: Assign to javier for vendor onboarding contact. Final action summary: Javier = ingestion + presigned + manifest + vendor contact; Morgan = KMS-proxy + deploy + kill-switch; Dmitri = RBAC + revoke automation; Tia = audit retention + trace-id + export; Lex = legal addendum. Dry-run Thu 10:00 PT.
infra_bot: infra-bot: scheduled dry-run reminder 24h prior and created runbook draft PR in docs repo. Link in ticket INFRA-PT-5370. :white_check_mark:
